Game Overview

At its heart, Aidan in Danger is a platformer game about join Aidan, a brave elf with a slingshot, on a thrilling quest to save Drakor, Earth's last dragon. Navigate time-twisting levels, battle fierce monsters, and conquer epic boss fights in this retro platformer.
